_about: Hand-checked rules for the loadout recommendation, applied by generate.py (tidy_tasks). requiredGear: equipment the wiki says must be worn for a task, so 'Recommend from my bank' keeps it in its slot. meleeReach: monsters melee cannot reach ('none') or only halberds and salamanders can ('halberd'); flying monsters (wiki attribute 'flying') get 'halberd' without an entry here. Item names match the wiki name exactly or with a ' (...)' suffix; a leading '*' matches any name containing the rest.

requiredGear.reason: against dragonfire (a super antifire potion frees the slot)
requiredGear.source: Slayer task pages' required items; Anti-dragon shield: 'mitigates the effects of dragonfire, reducing the maximum hit of most dragon-breath attacks by roughly ~80%'

requiredGear.reason: against dragonfire (a super antifire potion frees the slot)
requiredGear.source: Vorkath uses dragonfire; Slayer task/Blue dragons required items
Skeletal Wyvern: 'Like other wyverns, they require an elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield to reduce damage from their icy breath'
Basilisk / Basilisk Knight / Cockatrice / Moonlight Cockatrice: 'players must equip a mirror shield or V's shield when fighting these monsters'
Harpie Bug Swarm: 'A lit bug lantern ... is required to damage these monsters (the lantern must be lit and equipped)'
Killerwatt: max hit 15 without insulated boots, and that extra damage 'does not hit through the correct protection prayer'; Slayer task/Killerwatts required items
